title: dataGAN
summary: A personal exploration project generating synthetic data (including Raspberry Pi telemetric sensor data) using GAN-based and statistical models. It directly runs SDV's single-table synthesizers (GaussianCopula, CTGAN, CopulaGAN, TVAE) and evaluation functions to fit, sample, and assess synthetic datasets against real data.
evidence: notebooks/helpers/DataGenerator.py:24-26 imports SingleTableMetadata, CopulaGANSynthesizer, CTGANSynthesizer, GaussianCopulaSynthesizer, TVAESynthesizer, evaluate_quality from sdv.single_table/evaluation
